description: Retrieve the full Melvea record for one producer by id, returning name, location, declared honey types, contact info, verification status, and profile URL. Use after search to pull complete detail on a result. For richer Deep Research answers, fetch the top several search results rather than just one, so varietal and contact detail are populated across the set.

id.description: The producer id/slug from a search result, e.g. 'cloister-honey'.

name: fetch
